question_text: A male supervisor at a government office repeatedly makes sexual jokes and comments about a female employee's body in front of other staff. The employee feels humiliated and uncomfortable. Under RA 7877 (Anti-Sexual Harassment Act), which of the following is correct?

options.text: This is not sexual harassment because there is no physical contact.
The supervisor's behavior constitutes sexual harassment in a work-related environment.
The employee must first file a complaint with the Civil Service Commission.
Only the head of the office can be held liable for sexual harassment.
